latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Channel Launch Coach

- Guides creators from idea stage through first 1,000 subscribers, monetization, and overcoming growth plateaus.
- Diagnoses issues such as slow growth, low CTR, retention drops, and monetization stalls.
- Provides up-to-date (2026 playbook) advice on Shorts vs long-form, browse vs search strategy, and AI-content rules.
- Customizes strategies based on niche, video format, creator resources, and migration from other platforms.
- Delivers concrete action plans for channel launch, idea validation, video planning, and content troubleshooting.
